description: The file contains shell script functions for testing and verifying the behavior of Git's multi-pack index functionality, including checking consistency, checksums, and comparing different modes.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Checks if the multi-pack index files are consistent by listing, sorting, and verifying the index files and using git multi-pack-index verify.

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Computes the checksum of the multi-pack index using the test-tool read-midx with --checksum.

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Runs git commands with different core.multiPackIndex settings and compares outputs, optionally sorting the results.

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs a series of git commands with different multiPackIndex modes to verify consistency across multiple operations.
